projectDescription: A full-stack sports court reservation system with a TypeScript/Express REST API backend and a React/Vite frontend dashboard for managing courts (canchas) and bookings (reservas).
keyFeatures: JWT-based authentication with access token (15 min) and refresh token (7 days)
Court (cancha) management: list, get by ID, create with Zod validation
Booking (reserva) management: list all, create with overlap conflict detection
React + MUI dashboard with real-time stats (system health, total courts, active bookings)
PostgreSQL database with auto-initialized schema on startup
Docker Compose setup for local PostgreSQL
Seed script to populate 20 sample courts and 20 sample reservations
Role-based auth guards on frontend routes
Axios interceptor that injects Bearer token on every request
publicApiSurface: POST /api/auth/register — create a new user account
POST /api/auth/login — authenticate and receive accessToken + refreshToken
POST /api/auth/refresh — exchange refreshToken for a new accessToken
GET /api/auth/me — get the currently authenticated user
GET /api/canchas/:id — get a single court by ID (JWT required)
POST /api/canchas — create a new court (JWT required)
POST /api/reservas — create a booking with overlap validation (JWT required)
